rationale: R3: the fine-tune-from-traces market is shrinking (TensorZero archived 2026-06-12; OpenPipe closed to new training 2026-07-30 after the CoreWeave acquisition; Predibase redirects to Rubrik; Humanloop shut; Lamini team to AMD; Fireworks deprecated managed RL fine-tuning; OpenAI ends self-serve fine-tuning 2027-01-06 and Evals 2026-11-30 citing 'fewer use cases that require fine-tuning'). Upper rungs are still crowded (Distil Labs, Pioneer/Fastino, Inference.net Catalyst, Overmind) and the lower rungs by Microsoft SkillOpt-Sleep (MIT, 18.2k stars: nightly recurring-task discovery from Claude Code/Codex transcripts, held-out tests, human-approved skill changes). 'Deciding when fine-tuning is worthwhile' is unshipped by ~45 actors, plausibly because the answer is usually 'don't'. Provider terms (OpenAI API, Anthropic 2026-03-16 guidance, Google 2026-04-28) restrict training on outputs; routers trained on outcome metadata fit the classifier exceptions. Local training remains deferred under ADR-0010.
author: agent:fable-agentic-stack-20261009

criterion_rationales.competition: Distil Labs, Pioneer, Catalyst, Overmind (trace→specialist); SkillOpt-Sleep (skills); Agent Lightning/ART (training); Braintrust (log mining) — R3
criterion_rationales.revenue: Hosted fine-tuning vendors exiting; buyers appear to prefer stronger general models
criterion_rationales.legal_risk: Outputs-as-training-targets restricted by all three providers; needs legal review even for classifier exceptions
criterion_rationales.moat: Provenance-tracked data and retirement logic are genuine gaps with unknown willingness to pay
criterion_rationales.mvp_speed: Needs the outcome ledger (wedge C01) plus ≥30 recurring verifiable runs/month before any training experiment
criterion_rationales.founder_fit: ML engineer; directly usable on own workloads if volume materialises

recommendation: Hold as a venture; fold its cheapest test (recurring verifiable-task count from the ledger) into the fleet-controller wedge as a later 'specialization opportunity' report. Revisit if a task class exceeds ~30 verifiable runs/month.
